hypotheses.reasoning: At 06:32:03 ingest-api hot-reloaded config revision 604, changing ENRICHMENT_SVC_URL to http://enrichment-svc.internal:8443. Enrichment calls succeeded until about 06:32:11 (#1797 accepted, no enrich-ok after that). From 06:32:44 onward every ingest-api call to enrichment-svc is refused on 10.26.19.129:8443 (#1828, #1869, #1910, #2010). Gateway 503s (e.g. #1842, #2003) are downstream of ingest-api failing on enrichment. The reload is the only config change in the window, so it is the leading suspect, but the logs don't prove the new value is wrong: enrichment-svc was answering on 8443 moments earlier. Confidence is limited by this gap. report-cron's pandas failure (#509 and repeats) is an unrelated red herring.

Alternative: enrichment-svc stopped serving /enrich at about 06:32:10 and logged nothing but routine GC pauses (#1822, #1832, #1843) until the refusals began. A silent hang or crash of enrichment-svc, not the config change, would also produce connection refused and the 503s at the gateway. Its heap and GC looked normal, and it logged no error or restart, so this needs a process-level check.

verdict.recommendedAction: 1) Check whether enrichment-svc is running and listening on 8443 (process state, restart history, crash dumps around 06:32). 2) Diff config revision 604 against 603 and confirm the ENRICHMENT_SVC_URL target host and port. If the new value is wrong, roll back to revision 603 or fix the URL and reload ingest-api. 3) Restart enrichment-svc if it is wedged. 4) Separately, fix the report-cron image (report-cron:2026.10.2 is missing the pandas module); it is unrelated to this incident.

Enrichment calls succeeded until about 06:32:11 (#1797 accepted, no enrich-ok after that). The reload is the only config change in the window, so it is the leading suspect, but the logs don't prove the new value is wrong: enrichment-svc was answering on 8443 moments earlier. Confidence is limited by this gap. report-cron's pandas failure (#509 and repeats) is an unrelated red herring.

A silent hang or crash of enrichment-svc, not the config change, would also produce connection refused and the 503s at the gateway. Its heap and GC looked normal, and it logged no error or restart, so this needs a process-level check.
